_about: Named 12-channel looks for the SHEHDS 3W laser. values = CH1..CH12 bytes written verbatim by Laser.set_scene. color: 'palette' = the fan engine replaces CH12 with the show palette's colour band; 'fixed' = CH12 is sent as written. status: 'seen' = every byte was watched on Josh's unit; 'manual' = composed from the manufacturer's channel table (fixtures/builtin/shehds_3w_laser.json), not yet seen. engines/laser_scenes.py loads, checks and describes these; it can also compose new ones from named choices.

scenes.name: Rainbow
scenes.description: The Junior Crib fan: the line group, fastest horizontal sweep, held a little above centre, size cycling in and out at full speed, painting style 2 at full speed, outline at the top of its solid range, colour following the painting (the fan engine puts the show palette's colour here instead).

scenes.name: Slow Rainbow
scenes.description: Rainbow with everything slowed down: a third of the sweep speed, painting style 2 at its slowest, outline scan at half speed.

scenes.name: Rainbow Dots
scenes.description: The hardware-verified dotted line: dots outline, medium sweep, size held, no painting, colour following the painting.

scenes.name: Blue Sweep
scenes.description: The dotted line in blue, the fastest sweep. Blue stays blue whatever the palette.

scenes.name: Solid Line Sweep
scenes.description: The line as one unbroken stroke (solid outline, slow scan) sweeping side to side at a medium speed, in the palette's colour.

scenes.name: Spinning Line
scenes.description: The dotted line held still in the middle of the frame and turning clockwise at a medium speed, like a slow propeller, in the palette's colour.

scenes.name: Painted Line
scenes.description: The dotted line drawing itself in from one end (painting style 1, medium speed) while sweeping slowly, in the palette's colour.

scenes.name: Rainbow Line
scenes.description: The dotted line sweeping at a brisk speed with a rainbow running along its length ('flowing water', medium speed). Its own colours, whatever the palette.

scenes.name: Breathing Dots
scenes.description: The dotted line sweeping at a medium speed while its size pulses in and out, in the palette's colour.

scenes.name: Tumbling Line
scenes.description: The dotted line held centred and tumbling end over end (vertical flip spinning at a medium speed), in the palette's colour.
